title: ActionWaitForDigits
description: Waits for the caller to enter digits on the keypad, saves the input as a custom variable on the message, then triggers the associated response handler.

state_id.description: ID of the response handler that will be triggered when the response is received (e.g., "input"). Also used as the name of the variable where the entered digits will be stored (e.g. [[vars.input]].

max_digits.description: Maximum number of digits to wait for.

timeout.description: Number of seconds to wait after the last key press. Default: 10.

submit_on_hash.description: If true, submit the input when the caller presses #.
